passives.name: Maritime Protection
passives.description: (Passive Effect) If the caster has a buff when attacked, reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by [Buff_V_4044003_4_3]. Reduces damage taken from Fire, Water, and Earth enemies, and increases damage taken from Light and Dark enemies.

buffs.summary: −30% damage to boss if attacker has no element advantage/disadvantage
+15% damage to boss if attacker has element advantage
+45% damage to boss if attacker is Dark
